original.target_description: Published Trull & Sher (1994), single nonclinical young-adult cohort at Wave 4. Multiple regression predicting NEO-FFI Conscientiousness from gender and simultaneous lifetime diagnoses of any substance use disorder, any anxiety disorder, and major depression; target coefficient is for any substance use disorder. Openness corresponds to the supplied open-mindedness description; Neuroticism corresponds to negative emotionality.

notes:
Replication statistics are author-derived primary workbook values, retained without conversion, at supplied cell precision and with their original signs. ReplicationEffect, ReplicationPValue and ReplicationSampleSize refer to the same author-table row. No individual narrative success verdict was located; numeric success indicators were not treated as narrative verdicts. Original full primary paper unavailable through bounded public acquisition. Original values quoted in the replication workbook were not substituted.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind validation. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service; title and author match verified in supplied primary text. Quotes preserve OCR notation for beta, signs and spacing; es.value transcribes the printed coefficient. These are coefficients for diagnoses predicting personality while controlling diagnostic comorbidity, not logistic-regression coefficients predicting diagnosis. Tables 3 and 4 report N for different logistic regressions and are not used to assign analytic N to this target regression. No conversion performed. Replication and reported success intentionally unexamined.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .06, corrected effect .06 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 100/100. Observed author summary mapped to successful; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
